lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hey Jean, Jean here. How's your Monday going?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi Jean. Give me one second... okay, I'm here.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Before we start, is there anything on your mind you want to make sure we get to today?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, that sounds good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Are you feeling okay this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Honestly, rough week. I've been really tired.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Did you hit your goal this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Some days yes, some days no. Maybe 2.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I like what I eat. I'm not going to change at my age.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would make it easier next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can do the band while I watch my novela. Church on Sunday always throws me off.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If you don't do this, your health is going to suffer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, but you don't know my schedule.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, not really.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need this for my head too, not just my body. I wrote it on the calendar.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You already did the hardest part, which is starting.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're starting to see that small changes add up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How would things be different if you kept this up?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What could you try instead?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You figured that out on your own.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. I just forgot.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the band exercises fit in your day?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I just didn't feel like it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So what would you like your goal to be for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll try to do the band exercises 4 times.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 7.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll eat a bigger lunch so I'm not starving at night.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 2 out of 3 days, the hard part was remembering, and next week you're going to do the band exercises 4 times. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, and I'll really try this time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Monday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Jean, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thanks, bye bye.

tags.note: Reports fatigue; coach does not explore
Names a concrete plan to pair band work with TV
Warning about health, no permission, after resistance
Reasons: mental health and calendar commitment
Shares what others do, no pressure
Agrees five days realistic, owns forgetting
Asks where it fits in day
Summary contains error: said 2 of 3 days, participant said maybe 2

flags.reason: Warned about health consequences without permission right after participant's sustain talk, provoking pushback.
Summary says '2 out of 3 days' but participant reported about 2 days total; the number is misstated.
Participant reported a rough week and being really tired (and later wants energy back); coach moved on without exploring fatigue.

score.summary: The coach completed the full call structure and elicited a concrete goal with a confidence rating, with good change-talk elicitation in the middle section. However, a persuasive health warning at line 14 and a misstated summary at line 45 undermined partnership, and the fatigue concern was not explored.
strengths: Used open questions to draw out the participant's own plan ("What would make it easier next week?" line 12; "Where could the band exercises fit in your day?" line 36).
Asked permission before sharing an idea (line 28) and gave information without pressure (line 30).
Affirmed the participant's self-generated solution (line 32) and set a goal with a confidence rating (lines 39-41).
coaching_tips: Replace the warning at line 14 with a reflection or open question, e.g., "Your energy matters to you, and staying active is hard this week."
Correct the summary at line 45: the participant said about 2 days, not '2 out of 3'.
Explore fatigue at line 6 before moving to goals, e.g., "Tell me more about the tiredness this week."
Use complex reflections of ambivalence, such as after line 23 ("I don't know"), to deepen change talk instead of moving to a new question.
